style: Avant-garde vocal group pop and theatrical cabaret arrangement with 1970s dry studio band recording. Harmony: modal drone harmony with shifting scale-degree emphasis and chromatic side-steps, bitonal layers that retain separate tonal centers. Melody: chromatic cabaret patter that suddenly opens into sustained vowels, ornamental folk turns and hocketed fragments. Rhythm: additive asymmetric meter with abrupt silences, waltz pulse invaded by duple accents, motorik pulse with periodic missing beats. Timbre: harpsichord, prepared piano, upright bass, brushed percussion, breathy reeds, and mono tape bleed. Performance: deadpan bureaucratic solemnity with strict contrapuntal timing, theatrical overstatement played completely straight. Production: dry close-miked instruments, analog tape saturation, sudden spatial throws and absolute acoustic deadness. Operators: hold vocal counterpoint fixed while meter accelerates; compress structural intervals while stretching vowel decay; make mathematical proofs behave like melodic resolutions.
lyrics: [SECTION 1: TAXONOMIC REGISTRATION] [TEMPO CHANGE: 142 BPM] [HARPSICHORD DRONE] [SPOKEN BUREAUCRATIC NARRATION] Subject classification: A broken synthesizer that only outputs mathematical proofs of absence. [VOCAL GROUP HARMONY: CLOSE-POSITION] [CHORUS] We have logged the vacant terminal. We have cataloged the missing zero. The circuit board is clean of voltage. The oscillator hums of nothing. [VERSE 1] Theorem one: The absence of a wave implies the sine is locked in amber. Theorem two: The missing pin creates a void that registers as timber. We test the dial for missing resistance. We check the solder for non-existent persistence. We record the voltage drop across the non-conductor. We measure the silence with a brass caliper. [SECTION 2: CLERICAL AUDIT] [RHYTHMIC SHIFT: ASYMMETRIC 7/8 WALTZ] [CALL AND RESPONSE VOCALS] Operator A: Is the voltage present? Operator B: The voltage is classified as a missing integer. Operator A: Does the oscillator hum? Operator C: The oscillator hums an algebraic proof that this room has never been occupied. [BRIDGE: PROCEDURAL CHANT] [FAST PATTER SINGING] Form 104-B: Verification of void. Form 109-C: Acknowledgment of non-existence. Sign the ledger where the circuit melted. Stamp the file where the signal vanished. [MUTATION: FLOW GHOUL DISSOLVES THE HARDWARE] [INSTRUMENTAL BREAK: UPRIGHT BASS AND BRUSHED SNARE] [RHYTHMIC STUTTER] The copper traces are dissolving into depreciation rates. The solder joints are maintained by continuous administrative anxiety. The cabinet is not an object; it is an ongoing budgetary deficit. [SECTION 3: AXIOM DESTRUCTION] [AXIOM VANDAL INTERVENTION: NEGATE THE ENABLING RULE] [SPOKEN DEADPAN] We remove the assumption that a machine must contain matter to produce output. [OUTRO: ROOT SURGEON DECOMPILATION] [SLOWDOWN TO 60 BPM] [HARPSICHORD ARPEGGIO WITH TAPED BLEED] The primitive has been replaced with an alien root. caption: An avant-garde theatrical cabaret and vocal group pop song governed by taxonomic classification of absence, bureaucratic procedural narration, memory mutation, and metric asymmetry. A broken synthesizer outputs mathematical proofs of absence while upright bass, harpsichord, and prepared piano execute strict contrapuntal logic under hyper-dry 1970s studio production.
